scope: Read-only native analysis, source review and existing aggregate observations. No new game session, game-server request, proactive ping, collector behavior change, raw identity or packet is included.

nativeProgram.provenance: The reopened historical mobile research program was identified by local Ghidra metadata. Its previously verified binary fingerprint is also recorded in mobile-vehicle-pending-queries-2026-10-24.json. This is not a fingerprint assertion about a different current extracted game library.

defaultThresholds.proof: The initializer allocates four uint32 entries containing 30000, 40000, 50000 and 60000. Session construction at 0x00ad1fe0 selects g_sysPingTime by default.

scheduler.behavior: At each elapsed receive-idle threshold, increment the stage. The first three thresholds call SessionUnpackMethod::requestPing; the final threshold stores error -3 if no error is already present.
scheduler.largeClockJump: At most one threshold is processed per routine or pingCheck invocation. With stage 0 and more than 60 seconds idle, successive invocations process 30, 40, 50 and 60 seconds: three separate ping requests, then error -3. There is no catch-up loop within one invocation and no direct jump to the final stage.
scheduler.ordering: Session::routine first attempts a receive when marked readable; any positive bytes reset stage and timestamp. It then evaluates the idle threshold, flushes sends, and unpacks buffered messages. Decoding or dispatching an already-buffered message alone is not the positive-recv reset event.

wire.proactiveRequest: 0x00ad7058 constructs opcode 65530 (0xfffa) with an empty application payload.
wire.responseToReceivedPing: 0x00ad6fa4, onSysPingReq, constructs opcode 65531 (0xfffb) with an empty application payload. It does not inspect the incoming body.
wire.receivedAcknowledgment: 0x00ad710c, onSysPingAck, returns true without reading its incoming body.
wire.limit: These functions establish empty 65530/65531 messages. They do not establish a required opcode 65529 or a periodic client ping independent of receive inactivity.

positiveReceiveCorrection.behavior: Whenever recv returns a positive byte count, the function resets the ping stage at Session+0x40 to zero and records the current clock at Session+0x38.
positiveReceiveCorrection.correction: The reset is proven for any positive socket receive, even before message unpacking. The earlier INDEPENDENT_CONNECTION.md wording that complete messages reset inactivity is narrower than this inspected native condition. A ping acknowledgment is not the only traffic that resets receive inactivity.

existingOriginalClientObservation.limit: This completed passive original-client session observed server pings and corresponding client acknowledgments. It did not observe a proactive client ping and does not prove that proactive pings are unnecessary after an actual receive-idle interval.

collectorSourceAudit.acknowledgment: Both receive and the decoded-message drain use _dispatch_message. An actual received 65530 immediately calls send(65531) with an empty payload. ACKs do not use the 137/15/20 batch pacing delay or reset its timestamp.
collectorSourceAudit.quota: Only the per-instance 65531 quota scales with the reviewed session duration. Bonn has a 19800-second session and a 5500-ACK ceiling; other request limits remain unchanged. Exceeding this quota raises ValueError, mapped to protocol_or_snapshot_invalid, not connection_failed.
collectorSourceAudit.waits: Normal reply waits poll recv with a 0.4-second socket timeout and dispatch interleaved heartbeats. Primary-name waits have a 12-second transaction bound; normal reply waits have a 30-second transaction bound. Incoming heartbeats do not extend those transaction deadlines.
collectorSourceAudit.sendOnlyWindows: There is no concurrent socket reader during synchronous serialization, a send, or the explicit pacing sleeps. Mobile batch and nickname-group sleeps are 0.25 seconds; nickname fallback sends at most ten requests before receiving that group. Normal ranking and detail requests are followed by receive. No intentional multi-minute send-only period was found. Host scheduling or unexpectedly expensive processing cannot be bounded from this source review alone.
collectorSourceAudit.queuedMessages: receive can return once its predicate is satisfied, leaving already-decoded messages queued. Later receives and the vehicle recovery/finalization drains dispatch those messages normally. Drains consume only messages already decoded in memory and do not poll the socket.
collectorSourceAudit.establishedDifference: The collector does not implement the native proactive empty 65530 request after receive inactivity. This is a native-fidelity difference; no proactive-ping behavior was added during this investigation.
collectorSourceAudit.offlineVerification: Four focused tests passed: verified ACK-only dispatch, ACK bypass of batch pacing, queued heartbeat during vehicle recovery, and the exact scaled ACK quota boundary.

hostedBonnFailure.logProvenance: Aggregate completed Bonn job log timestamps and status inspected by the coordinating agent; other backend jobs were still active during this read-only audit.
hostedBonnFailure.retentionCaveat: 76797 is the retained last-good public snapshot count. It is not the number of rows completed by this failed fresh attempt. The 5000-row progress message is only its last periodic checkpoint; the failed-attempt final row count was not logged.
hostedBonnFailure.diagnosticLimit: At this commit connection_failed combines explicit decoded opcode317, socket EOF, connection reset and other send/receive OSError paths. This log has no heartbeat counts, time since last receive, ACK timing, or fixed transport-failure subtype, so it cannot identify a missed keepalive or distinguish those causes.

nativeSessionEndNotification.handler: 0x007d0588, NetMessage::onMessage<317>, identifies the fixed P_MC_PlayerLogout_Ntf name, obtains Login_Set and returns true. It does not read Message/param2 or a reason/status field.
nativeSessionEndNotification.diagnosticConsequence: Opcode 317 can be distinguished from socket EOF/reset by a fixed received-notification label. No arbitrary payload, reason number, identity or text should be parsed or logged without separate wire evidence. The collector's existing abort on 317 is a conservative session policy; this inspected native consumer itself performs no close.

conclusions: The collector's response to a received server ping matches the inspected native empty 65531 behavior.

The missing proactive receive-idle 65530 behavior is established, but its causal role in this failure is unproven. The native trigger depends on time without received bytes, not total session age near ten minutes.

Ongoing replies would reset native receive inactivity. Existing transaction deadlines often stop a silent wait around the first proactive-ping threshold, so the difference must not be assumed to explain every connection failure.

Privacy-safe fixed transport subtypes, current-attempt aggregate row counts, heartbeat counters and elapsed time since successful receives/sends/ACKs are needed to distinguish a server session-end message, EOF/reset and possible ACK starvation on a subsequent authorized run.
No extra ping, retry, reconnect, game login or rate change was performed or authorized by this note.

steamNativeHeartbeat.extraction: Installed PE bytes hashed over explicit VA ranges; x86 instructions inspected using GNU objdump.
steamNativeHeartbeat.method: Read-only GNU objdump analysis of the installed Steam PE; its Ghidra program was not open. Byte hashes cover the declared VA intervals, including explicit instruction ranges where identified.
steamNativeHeartbeat.timerProof: FUN_006893f0 installs 30000/40000/50000/60000 ms. BaseSession selects that default table at 0x00c0ee50 at instruction 0x0068522c.
steamNativeHeartbeat.wireProof: FUN_00689490 writes opcode 0xfffa at 0x006894c1 and sends an otherwise empty message; FUN_00689520 writes 0xfffb at 0x00689551 with the same empty application body. Thunk 0x00686110 invokes 0x00689490.
steamNativeHeartbeat.stageAndResetProof: 0x00685ec0 processes one timer stage per invocation; 0x00685915 tests a positive receive count, then 0x00685919 clears the stage and 0x0068592f/32 store the receive clock.
steamNativeHeartbeat.releaseScope: Static support for Steam is established; proactive Steam idle pings remain disabled for this mobile release by explicit scope. No live Steam keepalive verification is claimed.
